sam: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need a lightweight plan for cross-model precision stitching (when a request is routed from fp8 -> int8 variant or vice-versa). My main worry: output discontinuities at stitch points causing hallucination spikes.
neha: Agreed. We should define a "stitch map" per model-version that encodes safe switchable layer ranges and recommended warmup token counts. small and explicit. :+1:
juan: Quick sketch: a stitch map entry = (anchor_layer, pre_norm_scale, post_norm_scale, min_warmup_tokens). e.g. `{"anchor": 20, "pre_s": 0.98, "post_s": 1.02, "warmup": 6}`.
marta: How do we surface this in the runtime API? Maybe add `precision_stitch` field to the model manifest and an /inspect endpoint that returns the active stitch map for a variant.
neha: runtime API change seems fine. We should also add a validation step in the model onboarding pipeline that tests stitch transitions with our smoke prompts and flags >X% BLEU/ROUGE delta.
ops-bot: deploy-check: model-manifest-validator passed for model/galen-v2-int8 (CI #4128). No stitch map present.
sam: Ok — two parallel tracks: 1) short-term: manifest + runtime flag + smoke eval gating; 2) medium-term: implement a stitcher service to handle online smoothing (KV prefix blending + temperature ramp) and telemetry hooks.
juan: For the stitcher runtime heuristic, suggest linear interpolation of cached KV scales for first N tokens and a guard: if per-token perplexity jump > 2x baseline then fallback to pinned baseline-model for that request. Pseudo: ```if perp_ratio > 2: route=baseline```
marta: I can own the onboarding validator and add the stitch map lint. I volunteer to run a small shadow experiment: route 5% traffic through fp8->int8 transitions for gen-qa and log regression deltas.
neha: Thanks @marta. For the smoke eval, propose a two-tier threshold: soft warn at 5% quality drop, block at 12%. Also log prompt-level deltas and top-k token probability shifts.
sam: Great. Action items: @marta add validator + run shadow 5% (deadline Tue), @juan prototype stitch interpolation in the runtime shim (PR draft by Wed), @neha add gating thresholds to eval harness. We'll reconvene after the shadow run to decide on stitcher rollout. Thanks all.
